description: Chunk augmentation methods compared on SQuAD and ConditionalQA, each alone, generated by mistral-small-3-2-24b-instruct-2506. Slow: every method but title and summary makes one LLM call per chunk, at each of the six chunk sizes, and context shows the model the document each time (see the README's cost table). The other stages are at the README's baseline: fixed_token chunking, its max_tokens and overlap swept so that compare.py reports each alternative at its best, no augmentation, bge-m3, dense retrieval, no reranking. Run: .venv\Scripts\python.exe experiments.py experiments/augmentation_eval_squad_conditionalqa.json
